description:
Three process gaps were deferred from `codex-pr-review-followups-week-2026-05-03`
(DONE, 2026-05-04). All three relate to the quality of TODO `verification:`
blocks and the blind-spot remediation lifecycle:

(a) BUGGY VERIFICATION COMMANDS IN DONE FILES — Codex flagged verification
    commands in four DONE-state TODOs as likely broken: wildcard `--queries`,
    `find -newer` multi-arg arity, DuckDB filename glob, and `$(date)`
    recomputed across midnight (PRs #110, #117, #121, #122). These TODOs are
    in DONE and their commands are no longer run, but the patterns expose a
    class of silent false-positive "verified" completions. The fix belongs in
    `_project/audits/codex-weekly-sweep-template.md` — add negative checks for
    these antipatterns so the next sweep catches them before TODOs land.

(b) MULTI-LINE COMMAND: SCHEMA VALIDATION — A `verification.command` value
    containing unescaped newlines would silently misparse as multi-line YAML
    (surfaced by PR #161 review of
    `results-explorer-uat-methodology-blind-spot-remediation`). Extend
    `_project/scripts/validate_todo.py` or the JSON schema to reject
    `verification.command` values that contain newlines, so this class can't
    ship in a future TODO.

(c) ACTIONED-COMPLETION CONVENTION — When a blind-spot remediation TODO has
    acceptance criteria requiring all linked findings to end as
    `merged-to-todo` or `dismissed`, but one ends as `actioned` instead, the
    TODO fails its own completion gate even though the finding was addressed
    (surfaced by PR #163: `results-explorer-uat-methodology-blind-spot-remediation`).
    Decide: widen the criteria to allow `actioned` for convention-only
    remediations, OR amend the historical DONE entry. Document the chosen
    convention so future blind-spot remediation TODOs use it consistently.

anti_patterns.dont: add a blanket 'no multi-line commands' rule in the schema if intentional multi-line blocks (|) are used elsewhere
anti_patterns.why: scope the check to detect unescaped inline newlines only

anti_patterns.dont: amend the four DONE files' broken verification commands
anti_patterns.why: they are in DONE and should not be reopened; the template fix prevents recurrence

preserves.behavior: The codex sweep template remains runnable (do not add checks that require interactive approval)
validate_todo.py --all still passes all existing TODO/DONE files after the newline validation is added

prior_art.concept: _project/TODO/README.md — the natural home for the blind-spot remediation convention documentation
_project/TODO_SCHEMA.yaml — consider adding a pattern or format constraint to verification.command
_project/audits/codex-weekly-sweep-template.md — extend with antipattern checks rather than creating a parallel checklist
_project/scripts/validate_todo.py — extend existing validation rather than writing a separate linter

In _project/scripts/validate_todo.py or _project/TODO_SCHEMA.yaml, add
validation that rejects verification.command strings containing '\n'.
A multi-line command in YAML must use a block scalar (|) which already
signals intent — the validation should catch the accidental inline newline
case, not intentional multi-line blocks. Test with a synthetic TODO that
has a command with an embedded newline.
